verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents its own event-driven hooks: webhooks that send notifications of tailnet events (tailscale-docs-18), positioned as part of automating your tailnet (tailscale-docs-12), plus Shortcuts app actions for task automation (tailscale-docs-35). However, the evidence shows no in-product rule engine for defining conditions that fire actions, so any responding action must be built by the consumer outside Tailscale. Missing for 10: a native rule/condition-to-action engine, documentation of event types and filtering, built-in automated actions on events, and independent hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
